description: Use this when the user wants quotes or availability from 1 to 3 Servana businesses (slugs from search_vendors). It shows a quote request form with the details those businesses need (date, area, size and so on), pre-filled with what the user already said, so the user can check and send it. Prefer this over writing a free-text message. It sends nothing. Do not use for businesses that were not returned by search_vendors.

customer_email.description: The user's email, if they gave it

customer_name.description: The user's name, if they gave it

details.description: What the user already said, keyed by field: date_window, time_window, area, home_size, job_details, frequency, session_goal, session_count, treatment, shoot_type, duration, people_count, load_size, budget. Leave out what you do not know; never invent.

notes.description: Anything else the user wants to say

name: prepare_quote_request
